strings.59-ФЗ, статья 12, часть 1: рассмотрение: Federal Law No. 59-FZ, Article 12, part 1: reviewing a submission within the scope of competence.
strings.Авторизация освобождает оператора от люб: Authentication releases the controller from all data-protection duties.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение закона: Author's training summary of the law
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.В этой смене вы готовите проект решения: In this shift, you prepare a draft decision for the authorized head and organizational steps for the specified body. You do not order inspections or penalties on behalf of another agency. No real messages are sent.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
strings.Зафиксировать новый сбой разграничения д: Record the new access-control failure and send the minimum necessary information to the controller and competent unit.
strings.Как назван определённый в деле круг полу: How is the defined group of recipients described in the case?
How is the defined group of recipients described in the case? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.
strings.Какой вывод подтверждается сопоставление: Which conclusion is supported by comparing the materials?
strings.Крайний день рассмотрения обращения: Last day for reviewing the submission
strings.Кто ещё имеет доступ по протоколу?: Who else has access according to the report?
strings.Любая информация с веб-адресом является: Any information with a web address is public.
strings.На проверенном этапе неопределённый круг: At the verified stage, the table is not visible to an indefinite public; named recipients have access. The law distinguishes disclosure to an indefinite public from provision to a specific person or defined group.
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью, в которой различаются пр: Find the article distinguishing provision of data to specified people from dissemination to an indefinite audience.
strings.Наличие веб-адреса не означает доступ бе: A web address does not imply access without authentication. The report concerns a specific record; its conclusion does not extend to every service in the organisation.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Не квалифицировать ограниченный доступ к: Do not classify restricted access as a proven public publication; check the grounds and limits of the actual processing.

Do not classify restricted access as proven public publication; check the grounds and limits of the actual processing. A similar-looking website screen is not the same as open publication: the access mode and recipients change the conclusion.
strings.Нужно различать собственную запись и дос: Distinguish access to one’s own record from access to someone else’s.
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Объявить публичную утечку без подтвержде: Declare a public leak without confirming accessibility.
strings.Ограниченный доступ не исключает ошибки: Restricted access does not rule out permission errors; new information must be assessed separately.
strings.Ограничить вывод конкретным проверенным: Limit the conclusion to the particular service examined
strings.Основание обработки не сводится к публик: The basis for processing is not limited to publication.
strings.Отказать в любых объяснениях, потому что: Refuse any explanation because a password is required.
strings.Отклонить новые данные из-за вчерашнего: Reject the new information because yesterday’s report showed correct operation.
Public access has not been established.
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Пароль подтверждает законность любой пос: A password confirms the lawfulness of every subsequent operation.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.По данным дела подтверждён ограниченный: The case confirms restricted access, not dissemination to an indefinite audience; the response must address the established processing conditions.
strings.Подготовить ответ уполномоченного подраз: Prepare the competent unit’s response about the verified access mode and how to report other people’s records.
strings.Помощник: «Нет публичного доступа — знач: Assistant: “No public access means no further data complaints are possible.”
strings.Попросить прислать пароль для проверки ч: Ask for the password to be sent to unrelated employees for checking
strings.Последующий результат проверен по сущест: The subsequent result has been checked against the substance of the case.
strings.Похожий экран на сайте не равен открытой: A similar screen on a website is not the same as a public publication: the access mode and recipients change the conclusion.
strings.Появляется форма авторизации, таблица не: A sign-in form appears; the table is not visible.
strings.Предложить обсудить чужую запись в общем: Suggest discussing the other child’s record in the shared chat.
strings.Прекращение работы без выяснения обстоят: Stopping work without clarifying the circumstances
strings.Проверить подтверждённый перечень получа: Check the confirmed recipient list and the basis of processing
strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.
strings.Процедура предоставления услуги вместо о: A service-delivery procedure instead of reviewing a submission
strings.Публиковать запись ребёнка для проверки: Publish the child’s record to test users’ reactions
strings.Разъяснить представителю фактические усл: Explain the actual conditions and how to report a fault to the representative
strings.Рассмотрение обращения по закону № 59-ФЗ: Review of a submission under Law No. 59-FZ
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Сопоставить режим без входа и после вход: Compare access before and after signing in
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
strings.Сохранить материалы проверки и реагирова: Keep the verification materials and respond to new access information
strings.Существенное обстоятельство продолжения: A material circumstance in the continuation was left unchecked.
strings.Таблица оказалась в моём кабинете · пров: The table appeared in my account · checking the basis
strings.Только моего ребёнка. В служебном проток: Only my child’s. The internal report confirms this.
strings.Только названные сотрудники с необходимы: Only the named employees with access required for their work. The legal basis and purpose are attached.
strings.Только обстоятельства данной вымышленной: Only the circumstances of this fictional situation
strings.Требуется разъяснение и проверка границ: An explanation and verification of access boundaries are needed.
strings.Участник вымышленной учебной ситуации: Participant in a fictional training situation
strings.Учебная проверка: без авторизации запись: Training check: the record is unavailable without authentication; the legal representative sees only their own child; authorised employees are limited by their work duties. The materials verify the processing basis and proportionality to its purpose. An unrestricted audience has not been established.
strings.Учебное продолжение. На следующий день п: Training follow-up. The next day, the representative reports seeing another child’s record after signing in and provides evidence securely.
strings.Учебный материал; ссылка ведёт к правово: Training material; the link leads to the legal basis
strings.Хочу понять, кто видит запись и что дела: I want to understand who can see the record and what to do if someone else’s record appears.
strings.Чьи записи видны в вашем кабинете?: Whose records are visible in your account?
strings.Я увидела сведения о здоровье ребёнка на: I saw my child’s health information on the school-service screen and thought the entire internet could see it. I copied the page address, but my neighbour could not open it.
